gates.detail: Example sentence capitals/punctuation and contains the word.

issues: The word family lists only the plural 'minutes', which is an inflection rather than a true word-family member, so it adds little value.
The card does not mention that 'minute' is also an adjective (my-NYOOT, meaning 'very tiny'). This could confuse children when they meet the same spelling elsewhere.
The collocation 'last minute' is usually used as 'at the last minute' or 'last-minute' (adjective). Listed alone, it is slightly unclear.
suggested_fixes: Replace or supplement the word family with something like 'minute hand', or note that 'minutes' is the plural form.
Add a brief note: 'Careful: minute (my-NYOOT) can also mean very tiny.'
Change the collocation to 'at the last minute'.
